critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1150 lines and mixes 12+ concerns (auth, jobs, CO, BC, SC, team, calls, webhooks, chat, uploads, checkin, recovery, dispatch, storage) — split into modules before next iteration to keep files under 700 lines.

GHL signature verification silently returns verified=false when GHL_PUBLIC_KEY is blank AND still ingests the payload. That is intended for the demo (documented), but for production consider rejecting when a signature header is present but key not configured, to avoid silent tampering.

twilio_configured on User model is set only if BOTH twilio_from_number AND twilio_account_sid are in the PATCH payload; a client that sends only twilio_from_number will get twilio_configured=false even if backend env has SID/token. Consider deriving twilio_configured on-read from env + user fields.
In _chat_with_context, if 'wrap it up' AND 'change order' both appear the kickoff branch fires but the change-order branch is in an elif — as designed, no double-write. OK.

GHL webhook picks a target job for each extracted draft with a substring match on job['name']; if no active jobs exist it silently drops the draft (continue). Consider logging a warning so drops aren't invisible.

PATCH endpoints for change-orders/back-charges/schedule-changes accept ANY status string (Literal type-check happens at Pydantic response serialization, so an invalid string like 'foo' would 500 on response construction). Consider validating on request Pydantic model too.

Twilio env vars TWILIO_SID/TOKEN/FROM are captured at module import — /api/settings PATCH stores twilio_from_number on the user doc but the running _send_sms_sync only uses env vars. Backend restart still required to pick up new Twilio creds. Acceptable for MVP; document this.
In _build_super_briefing, `crew_name` derivation assumes last-token surname + ' Crew'; fragile for names like 'Rick Van Alan'. Consider storing crew_name explicitly on TeamMember.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Digest, Inbox, Calls + Add Super modal, Settings all verified in mobile viewport)

seed_data_creation: Reused POST /api/auth/dev-login seed (Mike, 3 jobs, 3 team members, 1 CO $3850, 1 BC $800 disputed, 2 schedule changes, 3 call logs). During the test run: (a) 1 TEST_super created + deleted (soft) — no residue in /api/team; (b) 1 outbound-SMS CallLog added by trigger-briefing (provider='outbox'); (c) 1 CO draft + 1 inbound SMS CallLog created by /webhooks/twilio/sms test; (d) 1 schedule_change draft + 1 inbound voice CallLog with ghl_call_id='test-ghl-iter4-1' created by /webhooks/ghl; (e) seeded CO status flipped to 'approved', seeded BC to 'resolved', seeded first SC to 'confirmed' — expected side-effect of PATCH tests (main agent: this is why the Digest KPI shows 'Drafts 1 / Back charges 0' in the frontend screenshot instead of the initial 1/1/2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_4.py -v`. Iteration-4 tests are self-contained and idempotent EXCEPT for the seeded-status mutations (CO->approved, BC->resolved, first SC->confirmed). If you need a fresh state, wipe the demo user's docs or use a new email in /api/auth/session. GHL replay-idempotency relies on `db.ghl_events.event_id` unique index — after startup log 'Weekly recovery scheduler started' should also appear. Twilio env vars are intentionally blank — outbox fallback is expected. Frontend: use viewport 390x844 (mobile). Tab labels in `_layout.tsx` are 'Digest'/'Inbox'/'Jobs'/'Calls' (title-case in DOM, rendered uppercase via textTransform) — use case-insensitive checks. Settings screen is at /settings (not a tab).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Note: KPI 'Drafts to review 1 / Back charge risk 0' in the digest screenshot is a side-effect of PATCH-status tests approving/resolving the seeded items during backend testing; it is not a UI bug.
